svg.title: The CPU tier's two failures
svg.desc: In panel a, where vLLM found the prompt tokens at their first schedule beside 24 agent sessions on the second GPU node, as shares of them, with the agents' tokens a second over the calls' first 240 s and their median time to first token: first come first served over a 20 GiB CPU tier, 9.1% found in the GPU pool, 1.5% loaded from the CPU tier and 89.5% computed, at 3,173 agents' tokens a second and a median time to first token of 76.8 s; first come first served over a 30 GiB CPU tier, 8.3%, 23.7% and 68.0%, at 2,958 and 76.7 s; and the queue over a 20 GiB CPU tier, 5.9%, 73.9% and 20.2%, at 7,270 and 4.5 s; in panel b, a step's time beside one 1.46 GB load from the CPU tier on that node's bare card, 5.7 ms alone at the median of the steps before each load, and the longest during it 192 ms on the copy engine in one batch of 32 KiB pages, 209 ms in one of 2 MiB pages, 152 ms in 23 jobs of 64 MB, 136 ms in 92 jobs of 16 MB on chained streams, and 6.1 ms through vLLM's Triton kernel with 4 programs.
